events.name: Halloween / Día de Muertos
events.notes: Late Oct through Nov 2 is effectively one continuous window. Historic figures fit Día de Muertos almost too well -- reuse the existing historia roster/engine with a themed promo push rather than a new page; consider a seasonal shareable card. Second priority after AR Dia del Estudiante.
